race.comment: AKARI SPIRIT (2) was an effortless maiden winner last time out over 1612m at Kilmore, scoring by 3.5 lengths. That followed some unlucky runs earlier in the prep, so he looks the clear testing material. WONDERING SPIRIT (4) resumed three weeks ago over 1500m at Mornington and was only beaten 1.5 lengths into fourth. Has a fair record when second up, including two top-three finishes. Strips fitter and can go on to take this out. PRINCESS SAKIKO (7) showed early speed from a good draw and led until entering the straight last start, eventually holding on for second and beaten 1.5 lengths over 2000m at Mortlake. Well-placed and can feature in the finish. EGERTON REEF (6) was dealt no favours at the draw, but was less than 1/2 a length off WONDERING SPIRIT last start, so if that's the right form, he's right in this. FOREST JIM (10) hasn't been beaten far at his past couple and draws to be in the finish again.
